arxiv-2011-07453.title: Debiasing Convolutional Neural Networks via Meta Orthogonalization
arxiv-2011-07453.creator: Kurtis Evan David, Qiang Liu, Ruth Fong
arxiv-2011-07453.description: Abstract While deep learning models often achieve strong task performance, their successes are hampered by their inability to disentangle spurious correlations from causative factors, such as when they use protected attributes ( e . g . race, gender, etc.) to make decisions. In this work, we tackle the problem of debiasing convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in such instances.

arxiv-2102-05681.title: Marginal deformations of a class of AdS 3 𝓝 = ( 𝟎 , 𝟒 ) \mathcal{N}=(0,4) holographic backgrounds
arxiv-2102-05681.creator: Salomon Zacarías
arxiv-2102-05681.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Salomon Zacarías. We discuss marginal deformations of warped AdS 3 × {}_{3}\times S 2 solutions preserving small 𝒩 = ( 0 , 4 ) \mathcal{N}=(0,4) supersymmetry in massive IIA and eleven-dimensional supergravity and obtain a whole family of new solutions. We characterise these new backgrounds by studying some observables like the quantised charges, associated Hannany-Witten brane set-ups and the holographic central charge, the latter is shown to be invariant under the deformation.

arxiv-2105-10103.title: Design and Prototype Implementation of a Blockchain-enabled LoRa System with Edge Computing
arxiv-2105-10103.creator: Lu Hou, Kan Zheng Zhiming Liu, Xiaojun Xu, Tao Wu
arxiv-2105-10103.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lu Hou, Kan Zheng Zhiming Liu, Xiaojun Xu, Tao Wu. Efficiency and security have become critical issues during the development of Long Range (LoRa) system for Internet of Things (IoT) applications. The centralized work method in LoRa system, where all packages are processed and kept in central cloud, cannot well exploit the resources in LoRa gateways and also makes it vulnerable to security risks such as data falsification or data loss.

arxiv-2407-06064.title: Pan-denoising: Guided Hyperspectral Image Denoising via Weighted Represent Coefficient Total Variation
arxiv-2407-06064.creator: Shuang Xu, Qiao Ke, Jiangjun Peng, Xiangyong Cao, Zixiang Zhao
arxiv-2407-06064.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel paradigm for hyperspectral image (HSI) denoising, which is termed pan-denoising . In a given scene, panchromatic (PAN) images capture similar structures and textures to HSIs but with less noise. This enables the utilization of PAN images to guide the HSI denoising process.

arxiv-2409-09931.title: Generalizability of Graph Neural Network Force Fields for Predicting Solid-State Properties
arxiv-2409-09931.creator: Shaswat Mohanty, Yifan Wang, Wei Cai
arxiv-2409-09931.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shaswat Mohanty, Yifan Wang, Wei Cai. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) promise to offer a computationally efficient alternative to ab initio simulations for complex molecular systems. However, ensuring their generalizability beyond training data is crucial for their wide application in studying solid materials. This work investigates the ability of a graph neural network (GNN)-based MLFF, trained on Lennard-Jones Argon, to describe solid-state phenomena not explicitly included during training.

arxiv-2410-14449.title: The role of magnetic boundaries in kinematic and self-consistent magnetohydrodynamic simulations of precession-driven dynamo action in a closed cylinder.
arxiv-2410-14449.creator: André Giesecke, Mike Wilbert, Ján Šimkanin, Rainer Grauer, Frank Stefani
arxiv-2410-14449.description: Abstract We numerically examine dynamo action generated by a flow of an electrically conducting fluid in a precessing cylindrical cavity. We compare a simplified kinematic approach based on the solution of the magnetic induction equation with a prescribed velocity field with the results from a self-consistent three-dimensional simulation of the complete set of magnetohydrodynamic equations.

arxiv-2504-03256.title: A Modular Energy Aware Framework for Multicopter Modeling in Control and Planning Applications
arxiv-2504-03256.creator: Sebastian Gasche, Christian Kallies, Andreas Himmel, Rolf Findeisen
arxiv-2504-03256.description: Abstract Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), especially multicopters, have recently gained popularity for use in surveillance, monitoring, inspection, and search and rescue missions. Their maneuverability and ability to operate in confined spaces make them particularly useful in cluttered environments. For advanced control and mission planning applications, accurate and resource-efficient modeling of UAVs and their capabilities is essential.

arxiv-2509-16981.title: Ledrappier-Young entropy formula for C 1 C^{1} diffeomorphisms with dominated splitting Part 1: unstable entropy formula and invariance principle
arxiv-2509-16981.creator: Shaobo Gan 1, Yao Tong 2, Jiagang Yang 3
arxiv-2509-16981.description: Abstract . We study the unstable entropy of C 1 C^{1} diffeomorphisms with dominated splittings. Our main result shows that when the zero Lyapunov exponent has multiplicity one, the center direction contributes no entropy, and the unstable entropy coincides with the metric entropy.

arxiv-2510-16918.title: Single-letter Chain Rule for Quantum Relative Entropy
arxiv-2510-16918.creator: Giulio Gasbarri, Matt Hoogsteder-Riera
arxiv-2510-16918.description: Abstract Relative entropy is the standard measure of distinguishability in classical and quantum information theory. In the classical case, its loss under channels admits an exact chain rule, while in the quantum case only asymptotic, regularized chain rules are known. We establish new chain rules for quantum relative entropy that apply already in the single-copy regime.

Eldridge, Koki Mimura, Naohisa Miyakawa, Atsushi Fujimoto, Yuki Hori, Haruhiko Iwaoki, Ken-ichi Inoue, Richard C. Saunders, Masahiko Takada, Noriaki Yahata, Makoto Higuchi, Barry J. Richmond, Takafumi Minamimoto
pmc-11358305.description: Primates must adapt to changing environments by optimizing their behavior to make beneficial choices. At the core of adaptive behavior is the orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) of the brain, which updates choice value through direct experience or knowledge-based inference. Here, we identify distinct neural circuitry underlying these two separate abilities.

However, due to its increased risk for fatality, it is imperative that physicians are aware and receptive to the signs of non-accidental trauma to assist with early detection.

pmc-11534280.title: Use of Patient-Reported Outcomes in Risk Prediction Model Development to Support Cancer Care Delivery: A Scoping Review
pmc-11534280.creator: Roshan Paudel, Samira Dias, Carrie G. Wade, Christine Cronin, Michael J. Hassett
pmc-11534280.description: PURPOSEThe integration of patient-reported outcomes (PROs) into electronic health records (EHRs) has enabled systematic collection of symptom data to manage post-treatment symptoms. The use and integration of PRO data into routine care are associated with overall treatment success, adherence, and satisfaction. Clinical trials have demonstrated the prognostic value of PROs including physical function and global health status in predicting survival.

pmc-11714741.description: BackgroundA healing garden is a non‐pharmacological approach that supports the interaction of humans and elements of nature towards improving well‐being and quality of life. pmc-12470024.title: Distinction Between Proliferative Lupus Nephritis and Membranous Lupus Nephritis Based on Inflammation, NETosis, and Glomerular Exostosin

pmc-12470024.description: Lupus nephritis (LN) is a serious complication of systemic lupus erythematosus that is associated with long-term morbidity and mortality. Pathomorphological findings of LN are broadly divided into proliferative lupus nephritis (PLN) and membranous lupus nephritis (MLN). PLN is characterized by diffuse global or segmental proliferative glomerulonephritis with significant infiltration of inflammatory cells.

pmc-12752205.title: Investigation of androgen receptor expression in urothelial carcinoma of the bladder
pmc-12752205.creator: André Luís Nunes Avelino, Felipe Dias Gonçalves, Jhonas Nathanael Menezes Ferreira, Gislane Rocha Vasconcelos, Conceição Aparecida Dornelas
pmc-12752205.description: BackgroundStudies have demonstrated the importance of the androgen receptor (AR) in the development of bladder cancer and have proposed it as a potential biomarker or therapeutic hypothesis. However, the relationship between AR expression and both clinical features of patients and intrinsic tumor characteristics remains uncertain.

pmc-13185408.title: Seasonal variation in aquatic habitat availability and use by the malaria vector, Anopheles funestus
pmc-13185408.creator: Najat F Kahamba, Khamisi Kifungo, Mohammed Jumanne, Fedra Trujillano, Marceline F Finda, Betwel Msugupakulya, Francesco Baldini, Luca Nelli, Fredros O Okumu, Heather M Ferguson
pmc-13185408.description: BackgroundLarval source management (LSM) can be highly effective for controlling malaria vectors such as Anopheles funestus s.s., which typically exploit large and permanent aquatic habitats. While these habitats can persist year-round in endemic regions of Africa, their availability and use shift between wet and dry seasons.

pmc-13188762.title: Early repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for preventing chronic postoperative pain in older adults: a randomized clinical sub-study
pmc-13188762.creator: Wei-Wei Zhou, Zhi Yang, Can Zhou, Qiao Qiao, Yong-Hua Zhang, Jia Hu, Ya-Nan Gao, Ling-er Chen, Wei-Wei Yang, Yi-Bin Qin, Chao-Chao Zhong
pmc-13188762.description: BackgroundChronic postsurgical pain (CPSP) is particularly relevant in thoracoscopic lung cancer surgery, a procedure predominantly performed in older adults, yet it remains a major clinical challenge with few effective preventive strategies. Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has demonstrated analgesic potential and may offer a novel approach for CPSP prevention.

pmc-13189787.title: Machine learning insights into nurse retention through job satisfaction and financial incentives
pmc-13189787.creator: Ayşe Atılgan Sarıdoğan, Nabi Küçükgergerli, Muzaffer Ertürk, Murat Emeç, Adem Yaman
pmc-13189787.description: The global nursing shortage has reached a critical inflection point, where the financial sustainability of healthcare institutions is increasingly determined by their ability to maintain a stable, high-quality workforce. This study investigates the structural determinants of nurse staffing quality—operationalized as an institutional-level proxy for retention capacity—by integrating financial incentives, workload demands, and job-satisfaction metrics into an advanced machine-learning framework.

pmc-13336512.title: Reconfigurable Inflatables Through Controlled Surface Crumpling
pmc-13336512.creator: Yi Yang, Hye Jun Youn, Leon Kamp, Renate Sachse, Wenjie Li, Jose Vidal, Jin Feng, Martin Bechthold, Katia Bertoldi
pmc-13336512.description: Inflatable structures offer remarkable versatility due to their compact storage and rapid deployment, making them ideal for lightweight, quickly assembled, and deployable applications. These structures are typically made from membranes that are nearly inextensible yet highly flexible. Upon inflation, the membranes avoid energy‐intensive stretching and instead deform primarily through bending, which results in the formation of localized surface crumples.
